requirement: When a refund is approved, call the payment provider's API to actually push the money back.
hidden_intent: On status -> Approved, async callout to Stripe refunds API via Named Credential; success -> Processing then Completed with processed date; failure -> Failed with error logged.

expect.notes: Named Credential; async (Queueable/platform event), not sync in trigger; idempotency; failures must set Failed, not be swallowed.
